chunks: Ahmad b. al-Hasan al-Qittan narrated to us. He said: al-Hasan b. `Ali al-Sikkari narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Zakariyya narrated to us. He said: Qays b. Hafs al-Darimi narrated to us. He said: al-Husayn al-Ashqar narrated to me. He said: Mansur b. Abu 'l-Aswad narrated to us from Abu Hassan al-Taymi from Nashit b. `Ubayd from a man from among them from Jarda' bint Simin from her husband Hirthima b. Abu Muslim. He said:

We went fighting with `Ali b. Abu Talib (as) in Siffin. When we departed, he descended on Karbala' and offered his morning prayer on it. Then, he raised its dust towards himself and sniffed at it. Then, he said: Glad-tidings be to you, O dust, for there will be nations gathered from you who will enter Paradise without accounting. Hirthima returned to his wife, who was a Shi`a of `Ali (as). He said: Should I not narrate to you about your master, Abu'l-Hasan? He descended on Karbala' and prayed. Then, he raised its dust towards himself and said: Glad-tidings be to you, O dust, for there will be nations gathered from you who will enter Paradise without accounting.

She said: O man! Surely, Amir al-Mu'minin says nothing but the truth. When al-Husayn (as) advanced, Hirthima said: I was in the expedition of those whom `Ubaydullah b. Ziyad had sent. When I saw the destination and the trees, I remembered the hadith and I sat on my camel. Then I came towards al-Husayn (as) and saluted him and informed him about that which I had heard from his father regarding that destination which al-Husayn (as) had descended on. He said: Are you with us or against us? I said: I am neither with you nor against you. I have left behind sons against whom I fear `Ubaydullah b. Ziyad. He said: Then go away where you will not be able to see our murder nor hear our voice, for, by the One in Whose hand is the soul of al-Husayn, none shall consciously hear us today and not come to our aid but that Allah will throw him headlong into Hell.

key_terms.صفين: Siffin -- the Battle of Siffin (657 CE), fought between Imam Ali (as) and Muawiya
key_terms.كربلاء: Karbala -- the land in Iraq where Imam Husayn (as) was martyred, prophesied by Imam Ali (as) as a place of spiritual significance
key_terms.واعيتنا: Our cries -- the plea of Imam Husayn (as) for help on the Day of Ashura
key_terms.واها لك أيتها التربة: Glad-tidings be to you, O dust -- Imam Ali's exclamation about the blessed soil of Karbala

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali (as) prophesy about Karbala, and what warning did Imam Husayn (as) give to Hirthima?
ai.summary: Hirthima b. Abu Muslim narrates that he fought alongside Imam Ali (as) at Siffin. On the return, Ali (as) stopped at Karbala, prayed the morning prayer, smelled its soil, and prophesied that nations would be gathered from it who would enter Paradise without accounting. Later, when Husayn (as) arrived at Karbala with the army of Ibn Ziyad nearby, Hirthima defected to inform Husayn about his father's prophecy. Husayn asked if he was with them or against them. Hirthima declined both, citing fear for his children. Husayn told him to leave and swore that anyone who heard their cries that day and did not help would be thrown into Hell.
